venue: Half pitch (full pitch for blocks 4 and 5)
equipment: Cones (4 colours) to mark the 5 lanes
theme: The rotation chain: FB in, 8 out, winger in
focus: In possession: when the 8 goes wide, the winger goes inside to keep two per lane, trap their full-back and set up the reverse pass and the ladder
objectives: Complete the 3-player chain (FB in, 8 out, W in) with the right timing
Read the opposition reaction: if their CM follows the 8, play the diagonal into the W; if their FB jumps to the 8, play the reverse pass behind for the W against their CB
Use the ladder (8 to 9, 9 sets first time, W runs in behind) to enter the circle
key_messages: "8 out, W in" - the winger's trigger is the 8 leaving the half-space
"Who follows?" - make their FB, CB or CM decide
"Reverse it" - the pass in behind their jumping FB

blocks.title: Ladder passing pattern with rotation

diagram.caption: x3 groups. 8 plays into 9, 9 sets back first time, W runs in behind and receives the through ball. Everyone rotates one position.

blocks.setup: Three 30x20m areas, 5-6 per group. Start cones for the 8 (yellow), 9 (orange), W (blue), finish cone (red). A second ball starts as soon as the W is away.
how: 8 plays into the 9's feet; the 8 follows the pass to support underneath.
9 sets first time back to the 8 (round the corner).
W times the run off the 9's set and receives the through ball from the 8, then dribbles over the red cone.
Rotation: 8 to 9, 9 to W, W back to the 8 queue.
After 5 minutes: add a passive defender on the 9.
blocks.link_to_theme: Grooves the ladder combination from the video and the habit of rotating into a new position.
coaching_points: 9 sets with an angled stick so the ball arrives on the 8's open side
W starts the run as the 9 sets, not when the 8 receives
8 plays the through ball on the first or second touch, weighted into the W's path
progressions: 9 can choose to set or turn (passive defender decides it)
blocks.activity_notes: Second ball goes as soon as the W leaves, so each player works every 20-30 seconds.

blocks.title: The 3-player chain: read who follows

diagram.caption: x2 (one unit on each half). LB has the ball inside, 8 goes wide, W comes inside. Their CM, FB and CB must choose who to follow.

blocks.setup: Half pitch, two units at once (one on each half of the full pitch). Per unit: LB, 8, LW, 9 (blue) vs their CM, FB, 2 CBs (red) + GK. Coach feeds the LB, who starts inside in the half-space (the Week 1 position).
how: LB receives inside. As the ball travels, the 8 drifts wide and the LW comes inside into the half-space.
Read 1 - their CM follows the 8: LB plays the diagonal into the LW coming inside.
Read 2 - their CM stays: LB plays out to the 8 wide. If their FB jumps to the 8, the 8 plays the reverse pass in behind for the LW against their CB.
Read 3 - the 8 receives and nothing is on behind: ladder - 8 into 9, 9 sets, LW runs in behind.
First 6 minutes the coach tells the red players what to do; then red go live at 75% and blue have to read it.
blocks.link_to_theme: Builds the whole chain from the video and the decisions it forces on the opposition.
coaching_points: Timing: the W only goes inside once the 8 has started going wide - too early and their FB just passes him on
LW comes inside on the blind side of their FB, then shows on the open stick side for the diagonal
8 wide: receive across the body facing forward so the reverse pass is a single action
Reverse pass is weighted into the space between their FB and CB, not to the W's stick
questions: Their FB jumped to our 8: where is the space now?
Their CM followed our 8 out: who is free?
progressions: Add their winger to press the LB (blue must play quicker)
regressions: Coach calls the read (1, 2 or 3) as the ball goes in
blocks.activity_notes: Two units of 8 on separate halves. Swap blue and red roles every 4 reps; switch to the right-hand side halfway through.

blocks.title: 6v5 + GK: rotation to goal

diagram.caption: Blue 6 attack the full goal from a CB feed. Red 5 + GK defend and counter into 2 mini goals. Goal from the reverse pass or ladder = 2.

blocks.setup: Half pitch. Blue 6 (CB, LB, 6, 8, LW, 9) vs red 5 (CM, W, FB, 2 CBs) + GK. Two mini goals on the halfway line for red. 5 spare players work as a second group and swap in every 4 minutes.
how: Every rep starts with a coach feed into the blue CB on the halfway line.
Blue score in the full goal: 1 goal, or 2 if the goal comes from the reverse pass or the ladder.
Red win it: score in either mini goal within 6 seconds.
Play both sides: first 10 minutes build down the left, last 10 down the right.
blocks.link_to_theme: The chain against live opposition who are trying to stop it, with a reward for the two key finishes.
coaching_points: Make them decide: hold the wide and half-space positions long enough that their FB has to choose
Ball speed after the rotation - the advantage lasts about 2 seconds
9 stays high to pin both CBs until the ladder is on, then drops to set
Rest-defence: CB and 6 stay connected to stop the counter
regressions: Red FB must stay in the wide lane
blocks.activity_notes: Second group of 5 runs a 3v2 rondo in a 15x15 grid behind the halfway line while waiting, then swaps in every 4 minutes.

step.task: Count rotations completed as well as goals
step.people: Fittest group plays red so blue face proper pressure

blocks.title: 8v8 + GKs: who follows? game

diagram.caption: 8v8 + GKs. Every restart builds from the GK. Goal from a W who started wide and finished inside, or from the ladder = 2.

blocks.setup: Full pitch, 8v8 + GKs. Each team: 2 CBs, LB, 6, 8, LW, 9, RW. Any spares rotate in every 4 minutes.
how: Restarts are always a GK pass to a CB.
Goal from the reverse pass / diagonal into the inside W, or from the ladder = 2 goals.
Coach freeze once every 4 minutes on a good or missed rotation (30 seconds max).
Last 5 minutes: free play, no bonus - see if it sticks.
blocks.link_to_theme: Puts the chain into a full-intensity game with transitions, so timing and recognition are tested under fatigue.
coaching_points: Recognise the picture in the game - it won't look as tidy as the drill
If the chain breaks, re-form two per lane before forcing it
Opposite 8 and RW push up to make it 4 v their back 3/4 when the reverse pass goes
progressions: Bonus only if the rotation happens on the right-hand side (weaker side)
regressions: Neutral floater plays for the team in possession
blocks.activity_notes: Everyone plays; ball-stocks behind both goals for instant restarts.

blocks.title: 11v11 (or numbers available): run the chain
blocks.setup: Full pitch match, normal rules. Swap bibs at 10 minutes.
how: Normal game.
Focus: when the 8 goes wide, the winger goes inside - every time.
Coach tallies completed rotation chains and circle entries that came from them.
coaching_points: Timing of the winger's inside run
The reverse pass in behind their FB
Week 1 still applies - two in every lane
questions: Who did their full-back follow? What did that open up?

safety: Shin guards and gum shields for all
Reverse passes are on the floor - no raised balls into the circle in blocks 2-3
reflection_prompts: Was the winger's timing right, or did they go inside too early?
Which read (follow / stay / jump) did players spot most easily?
Which players need the chain walked through again before Week 3?
